label: Updated at 12 p.m. ET
title: Today In Golf
summary: A 30-second briefing on today's biggest golf stories.

items.headline: BMW Championship Lead
items.text: Wyndham Clark holds a five-shot lead entering Sunday at the BMW Championship with a chance to add a major milestone to his strong 2026 season.

items.headline: Tiger Woods Court Date
items.text: Tiger Woods will make his first court appearance on September 8 in his DUI case related to a March rollover crash on Jupiter Island, Florida.

items.headline: Rory McIlroy's BMW Bounce-Back
items.text: Rory McIlroy has recovered well from a poor week in Memphis and will play alongside Wyndham Clark in the final group Sunday at the BMW Championship.
